name: cf-index
title: CF Index
description: Full CRUD index page with data table, row actions, create/edit form dialog, toast notifications, and Inertia.js pagination/sorting/search integration.
author: GT264 <ferretti.m91@gmail.com>
docs: This is the main CRUD index page. It requires Inertia.js with shared crudLang translations and Ziggy route helpers. Make sure your Laravel backend shares column_data, columns_details, route_prefix, and crud_buttons as Inertia props.
